latest_release.body:
This is a security-focused patch. It addresses the [eMudhra Intermediate CA compromise](https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/), and it also includes two configuration fixes and one change to `vroom` that you'll want to know about. The ClickHouse image is the one remaining unpatched image. It depends on upstream Altinity publishing a patched image, so we're tracking that and will ship the update as soon as it's available.

### Changes to Check

- **`vroom` now uses Distroless by default:** The `vroom` image is now built on Distroless, which strips out package managers, shells, and other components a running service doesn't need. That shrinks the attack surface, which is the main reason for the switch. Check that nothing in your setup depends on a shell being present inside that container.
- **`SENTRY_BUCKET_PROFILES` on `vroom`:** This environment variable needs the `http://` scheme included in its value. Without it, the setting doesn't behave as expected. If you set this variable, make sure the scheme is present.
- **Uptime checker region config:** If you're using the uptime monitoring feature, you need to configure the uptime checker regions in `sentry/sentry.conf.py`. This one matters if uptime monitoring is part of your setup, so please don't skip it.
- As a result of the certificate changes, `SETUP_CUSTOM_CA_CERTIFICATE=1` users must re-run `./install.sh`. 
- Symbolicator base images have moved to Debian 13

Nothing else in this release is notable. It's a focused patch.

---

We're always happy to chat. If you run into a problem during the upgrade, or just want to talk through your setup, reach out to us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/sentry).

### Bug Fixes 🐛

- (scripts) Backup never shut down the compose stack by @aldy505 in [#4565](https://github.com/getsentry/self-hosted/pull/4565)
- (sentry) Use the env var name gRPC reads for the CA bundle by @geoffg-sentry with @sentry-junior in [#4596](https://github.com/getsentry/self-hosted/pull/4596)
- (uptime) Configure uptime-checker API endpoint for Test Monitor and assertion validation by @ayoubjemai in [#4583](https://github.com/getsentry/self-hosted/pull/4583)
- (vroom) Add the scheme to the SeaweedFS endpoint in SENTRY_BUCKET_PROFILES by @oioki in [#4573](https://github.com/getsentry/self-hosted/pull/4573)

### Internal Changes 🔧
